mathematical_contract.composition: For D(t)=C(t)+d*N_C(t), every retained regular cusp-free span has D'(t)=lambda(t) C'(t) with fixed nonzero sign. A signed left offset e along the retained traversal is therefore the same source carrier at d+e when the traversal normal agrees with N_C and at d-e otherwise.
mathematical_contract.orientation: The sign of lambda is certified at one exact rational interior parameter. Reversed traversal flips the normal independently. Reversed split output reverses both each fragment traversal flag and the fragment vector order.
mathematical_contract.cusp_partition: The combined-distance parallel runs the authoritative exact singularity analysis. Every new open-range cusp becomes a retained split boundary; source singularities on a nonzero-distance range remain explicit Unsupported evidence.
mathematical_contract.limiting_tangents: At cusp endpoints the join engine receives the adjacent regular interval's source tangent multiplied by the certified parallel-scale and traversal signs, never a zero cusp derivative.
mathematical_contract.lazy_roles: Only an authoritative filled-left arrangement walk can publish the regularized-topology marker. Multi-loop nesting is then derived exactly on demand using retained-curve ray classification and conservative exact bounds; ordinary completion does not pay for unused role evidence.
mathematical_contract.source_kernel: Changing only the signed parallel distance allocates a new one-word carrier and distance-dependent PH cache while sharing immutable source geometry, polynomial power basis, and homogeneous differential evidence.
mathematical_contract.represented_scale_fast_path: At represented parameters the derivative-scale sign is decided from exact H, H', W, d, |H|^2, and the same cusp polynomial identity used by the algebraic-parameter certificate. It constructs neither a normalized derivative nor a square root.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 use identical construction and topology. APPROXIMATE_512 may decide only an otherwise unresolved terminal equality/sign; the rational benchmark fixture remains fully Certified under both policies.
